it.#Did any of these happen on this trip? (: Durante questo spostamento è successo uno di questi episodi? (Puoi sceglierne più di uno)
it.#I was nearly hit by a car, van, bus or: Un'auto, un furgone, un autobus o una moto ha rischiato di investirmi o di urtarmi
it.#A vehicle did not stop for me at a zebr: Un veicolo non si è fermato per farmi attraversare sulle strisce
it.#A close call with a bike or e-scooter: Ho rischiato uno scontro con una bici o un monopattino
it.#A car door was opened in front of me: Qualcuno ha aperto la portiera di un'auto davanti a me
it.#An obstacle on the pavement got in my w: Un ostacolo sul marciapiede mi ha bloccato il passaggio
it.#A kerb without a ramp, or a blocked ram: Un bordo del marciapiede senza scivolo, o uno scivolo bloccato, mi ha ostacolato
it.#I stumbled, tripped or fell: Ho inciampato, ho perso l'equilibrio o ho fatto una caduta
it.#I was harassed, threatened or made to f: Ho subito molestie, minacce o comportamenti che mi hanno creato disagio
it.#A vehicle passed too close to me: Un veicolo mi è passato troppo vicino
it.#A lift or escalator I needed was out of: Un ascensore o una scala mobile che mi serviva era fuori servizio
it.#I could not find a parking space, or on: Non ho trovato parcheggio, o solo lontano dalla mia meta
it.#I felt a little uneasy, but nothing hap: Ho provato un po' di disagio, ma non è successo nulla
it.#Announcements or travel information tha: Annunci o informazioni sul viaggio che non potevo sentire o leggere

fr.#Did any of these happen on this trip? (: L'une de ces situations s'est-elle produite pendant ce trajet ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s'appliquent)
fr.#I was nearly hit by a car, van, bus or: Une voiture, une camionnette, un bus ou une moto a failli me renverser
fr.#A vehicle did not stop for me at a zebr: Un véhicule ne s'est pas arrêté pour me laisser traverser au passage piéton
fr.#A close call with a bike or e-scooter: J'ai failli entrer en collision avec un vélo ou une trottinette électrique
fr.#A car door was opened in front of me: Une portière de voiture a été ouverte juste devant moi
fr.#An obstacle on the pavement got in my w: Un obstacle sur le trottoir m'a barré le passage
fr.#A kerb without a ramp, or a blocked ram: Un bord de trottoir sans rampe, ou une rampe bloquée, m'a barré le passage
fr.#I stumbled, tripped or fell: J'ai trébuché, perdu l'équilibre ou fait une chute
fr.#A bus ramp did not work: La rampe d'accès du bus ne fonctionnait pas
fr.#I was harassed, threatened or made to f: J'ai subi du harcèlement, des menaces ou des comportements qui m'ont causé un malaise
fr.#A vehicle passed too close to me: Un véhicule est passé trop près de moi
fr.#A lift or escalator I needed was out of: Un ascenseur ou un escalator dont j’avais besoin était en panne
fr.#I could not find a parking space, or on: Je n’ai pas trouvé de place pour me garer, ou seulement loin de ma destination
fr.#I felt a little uneasy, but nothing hap: J’ai ressenti un léger malaise, mais rien ne s’est passé
fr.#Announcements or travel information tha: Des annonces ou des informations sur le trajet que je ne pouvais pas entendre ou lire

de.#A close call with a bike or e-scooter: Beinahe-Zusammenstoß mit einem Fahrrad oder E-Scooter
de.#A car door was opened in front of me: Vor mir wurde eine Autotür geöffnet
de.#An obstacle on the pavement got in my w: Ein Hindernis auf dem Gehweg hat mir den Weg versperrt
de.#A kerb without a ramp, or a blocked ram: Ein Bordstein ohne Rampe oder eine zugestellte Rampe hat mir den Weg versperrt
de.#I stumbled, tripped or fell: Ich bin gestolpert, gestrauchelt oder gestürzt
de.#A bus ramp did not work: Die Rampe des Busses funktionierte nicht
de.#I was harassed, threatened or made to f: Ich wurde belästigt, bedroht oder fühlte mich durch das Verhalten anderer unwohl
de.#A vehicle passed too close to me: Ein Fahrzeug ist zu nah an mir vorbeigefahren

tr.#Did any of these happen on this trip? (: Bu yolculukta bunlardan herhangi biri oldu mu? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#I was nearly hit by a car, van, bus or: Az kalsın bir otomobil, kamyonet, otobüs veya motosiklet bana çarpıyordu
tr.#A vehicle did not stop for me at a zebr: Bir araç, yaya geçidinde geçmem için durmadı
tr.#A close call with a bike or e-scooter: Bir bisiklet veya elektrikli scooter ile çarpışmaktan kıl payı kurtuldum
tr.#A kerb without a ramp, or a blocked ram: Rampasız bir kaldırım kenarı veya önü kapalı bir rampa yolumu kapattı
tr.#I was harassed, threatened or made to f: Taciz edildim, tehdit edildim veya rahatsız edici bir durumla karşılaştım
tr.#A lift or escalator I needed was out of: İhtiyacım olan bir asansör veya yürüyen merdiven çalışmıyordu
tr.#I could not find a parking space, or on: Park yeri bulamadım ya da yalnızca gideceğim yerden uzakta buldum
tr.#I felt a little uneasy, but nothing hap: Biraz tedirgin oldum ama bir şey olmadı
tr.#Announcements or travel information tha: Duyamadığım veya okuyamadığım yolculuk duyuruları ya da bilgileri

fa.#Did any of these happen on this trip? (: آیا در این سفر یکی از این موارد رخ داد؟ (همه موارد مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#I was nearly hit by a car, van, bus or: نزدیک بود یک ماشین، ون، اتوبوس یا موتورسیکلت با من برخورد کند
fa.#A vehicle did not stop for me at a zebr: یک وسیله نقلیه در خط عابر پیاده برای من توقف نکرد
fa.#A close call with a bike or e-scooter: نزدیک بود با یک دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی برخورد کنم
fa.#A car door was opened in front of me: درِ یک خودرو جلوی من باز شد
fa.#An obstacle on the pavement got in my w: مانعی روی پیاده‌رو راه مرا بست
fa.#A kerb without a ramp, or a blocked ram: لبه پیاده‌رو بدون رمپ، یا رمپ مسدود، راه مرا بست
fa.#I stumbled, tripped or fell: سکندری خوردم، پایم گیر کرد یا زمین خوردم
fa.#I was harassed, threatened or made to f: مورد مزاحمت یا تهدید قرار گرفتم یا رفتاری باعث ناراحتی من شد
fa.#A vehicle passed too close to me: یک وسیلهٔ نقلیه خیلی نزدیک از کنارم رد شد
fa.#A lift or escalator I needed was out of: آسانسور یا پله برقی‌ای که لازم داشتم از کار افتاده بود
fa.#I could not find a parking space, or on: جای پارک پیدا نکردم، یا فقط دور از مقصدم پیدا کردم
fa.#I felt a little uneasy, but nothing hap: کمی احساس ناراحتی کردم، اما اتفاقی نیفتاد
fa.#Announcements or travel information tha: اعلان‌ها یا اطلاعات سفر که نمی‌توانستم بشنوم یا بخوانم

hu.#An obstacle on the pavement got in my w: A járdán egy akadály elállta az utamat
hu.#A kerb without a ramp, or a blocked ram: Rámpa nélküli járdaszegély vagy eltorlaszolt rámpa állta az utamat
hu.#I stumbled, tripped or fell: Megbotlottam, elvesztettem az egyensúlyomat vagy elestem
hu.#I was harassed, threatened or made to f: Zaklattak, megfenyegettek, vagy kellemetlen helyzetbe kerültem

ar.#Did any of these happen on this trip? (: هل حدث أي من هذه الأمور في هذه الرحلة؟ (يمكن اختيار كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#I was nearly hit by a car, van, bus or: كدت أن تصدمني سيارة أو شاحنة صغيرة أو حافلة أو دراجة نارية
ar.#A vehicle did not stop for me at a zebr: لم تتوقف مركبة لتسمح لي بالعبور عند ممر المشاة
ar.#A close call with a bike or e-scooter: كدت أن أصطدم بدراجة أو سكوتر كهربائي
ar.#A kerb without a ramp, or a blocked ram: اعترضت طريقي حافة رصيف بلا منحدر، أو منحدر مسدود
ar.#I stumbled, tripped or fell: تعثرت أو اختل توازني أو سقطت
ar.#I was harassed, threatened or made to f: تعرضت لتحرش أو تهديد أو لما سبّب لي انزعاجًا
ar.#A lift or escalator I needed was out of: كان مصعد أو سلم متحرك أحتاج إليه معطلًا
ar.#I could not find a parking space, or on: لم أجد مكانًا لركن السيارة، أو وجدته بعيدًا عن وجهتي فقط
ar.#I felt a little uneasy, but nothing hap: شعرت ببعض الانزعاج، لكن لم يحدث شيء
ar.#Announcements or travel information tha: إعلانات أو معلومات عن الرحلة لم أتمكن من سماعها أو قراءتها
